about: Gate 15's HM block (TC-GL-012): while a Preview-gallery card's instruction is held, the Review header's menu button hit-tests to itself (HM1), no on-screen button has its centre taken by the bar's back or Hide control (HM2), both controls lie inside the bar's box (HM3), and a real tap on the menu button opens the menu sheet with the bar still up (HM4). Graded at 375x761 (his phone), 320x568 and 730x375. The fix itself landed at #550 (controls inside the bar, bar under the header); this job's remainder is the proof. NOT COVERED: the other gate 15 blocks (CT_G15_ONLY=HM runs this one alone), and 390x844.

breaks.name: hide-hangs-above-the-bar
breaks.why: the Hide control goes back to hanging 16px above the bar's top-right corner, where the header menu button is: the tap lands on Hide

breaks.name: bar-back-up-at-18
breaks.why: the bar goes back up to 18px from the top with its controls inside it, so the Hide control sits over the header's menu button

breaks.name: hide-sticks-out-sideways
breaks.why: the Hide control is pushed out past the bar's right edge, so it protrudes from the bar's box
